project: bSafe — Women Safety & Emergency Assistance Platform

backend.description: Fast, unopinionated minimalist web server framework for REST API endpoints.
Object Data Modeling (ODM) library for MongoDB, handling geospatial 2dsphere indexing for emergency radius searches.
Signs and verifies application JWT tokens with HMAC-SHA256 and RS256 algorithms.
One-way salted hashing algorithm for user credentials and local authentication.
WebSocket server enabling live SOS alert dispatching and real-time GPS coordinate streaming.
Google APIs client for cryptographic ID token verification and Google OAuth2 code exchange.
Cross-Origin Resource Sharing middleware controlling authorized browser origins.
Secures HTTP response headers with strict Cross-Origin-Opener-Policy for OAuth popups.
Rate limiting middleware preventing brute-force login attempts and API abuse.
Zero-dependency module that loads environment variables from .env into process.env.
Monitors file changes and automatically restarts the backend server during development.

frontend.description: React framework with App Router, server-side rendering, and static optimization.
Core declarative component library for building reactive user interfaces.
React package serving as the entry point to the DOM and server rendering.
Firebase Client SDK for Google Popup Authentication and client telemetry.
Client WebSocket connection for listening to active alerts and emitting live location updates.
React bindings for Leaflet map components.
Beautiful, accessible icon library with consistent aesthetic for safety alerts and dashboard UI.
Utility-first CSS framework for responsive dark-mode styling and glassmorphism UI.
Typed superset of JavaScript ensuring robust compile-time contract enforcement.

backend.name: PORT

backend.name: NODE_ENV
backend.description: Application environment mode ('development' or 'production').

backend.name: FRONTEND_URL
backend.description: Allowed CORS origin and redirect target for OAuth callbacks.

backend.name: MONGODB_URI
backend.description: MongoDB Atlas connection URI including username, password, cluster, and database name.

backend.name: JWT_SECRET
backend.description: Cryptographic secret key for signing JSON Web Tokens. Must be at least 32 characters in production.

backend.name: FIREBASE_PROJECT_ID
backend.description: Firebase project ID used to verify Firebase ID tokens against Google x509 public signing keys.

backend.name: GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID
backend.description: Google Cloud Console OAuth 2.0 Client ID for direct redirect flow.

backend.name: GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET
backend.description: Google Cloud Console OAuth 2.0 Client Secret for code exchange.

backend.name: GOOGLE_CALLBACK_URL
backend.description: Authorized OAuth 2.0 callback redirect URI.

frontend.name: NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL
frontend.description: Public URL of the backend REST and authentication API.
